falsifiable_hypothesis: A worker process or session lost mid-flight leaves no false completion and the unit is resumable from immutable input.
limitations: Session loss after a durable RESULT_COMMITTED is prescribed a rerun rather than a replay, so the first committed result is superseded and the same work is performed twice; that unreplayed durable work is the separate FAIL recorded as DEF-PO03-C6-042. A lost session also leaves no explicit abandoned marker because lease lifetime is not enforced (DEF-PO03-C6-045), so a coordinator cannot tell how long to wait before transferring. The matrix records a sha256 and byte count for all 15 source files but a durable git blob id for only 13: this unit's own injection-report.json and observation-record.json are compiled before the commit that makes them durable, and both are resolvable from f712fbf. No subagent spawning tool was exposed in this runtime, so provider_run_id is NOT_SUPPORTED and all eight units ran sequentially in one runtime.
